Search results are a bounded sample, not a complete census of businesses in this area.
Unlisted businesses and missing map data are not proof of an opportunity.
Research scores use ratings and review counts, not footfall, rent, revenue or population.
Building heights come from map data. Business ratings never change geographic building heights.

evidence.recommendation: Staff & experience appears in low-rated sampled reviews from 3 businesses. Review service interactions and train staff to resolve problems clearly.
caveats: Themes are English keyword matches grouped by review rating. A theme is a prompt for manual review, not a proven complaint.
Newest reviews are a small sample, not the full customer population. Mixed sentiment and sarcasm may be misclassified.
One snapshot cannot establish business growth, sales, market demand or changes in reputation.
These businesses and reviews are invented demonstration records. Do not use them for decisions.
